name: video-platform-app
description: Video Data Collection & Multi-Role Platform for Mobile App (Candidates, Vendors, Admin)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix admin-dashboard install && npm --prefix vendor-dashboard install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,ADMIN,VENDOR" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix admin-dashboard run dev" "npm --prefix vendor-dashboard run dev"
